issues: The summary, key points and the three quotes match the post. Quote 3 uses a hyphen where the post has a dash, which is acceptable.
The post does not support the 'integration' system. It is about a development tool for managing object IDs and does not cover integrations.
The summary gives the change date as 1 January 2026. The post says the service stays free until 31 December 2025, so this is a reasonable reading.
The post also mentions a lifetime 35% discount for users who stay on the premium backend. The page leaves this out, but the omission is minor.
